chapters.title: Welcome to Maple Hollow
chapters.completeText: Pearl's cottage has a room just for us, under the roof. Tomorrow we start work in her studio!

tasks.prompt: Pearl the painter meets our bus with a sign she made herself. Read what is painted on it.
tasks.success: A big red heart - in Maple Hollow that means welcome!

tasks.prompt: On the wall by the bus stop, someone has drawn a funny picture. Read what is in it.
tasks.success: Two black cats - the village children drew them in chalk.

tasks.prompt: The yard next to the bus stop is full of animals. Read who is in it and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Three dogs sing a howly welcome song!

tasks.prompt: In the window of the toy shop by the bus stop, one thing has a price tag. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A small blue car - Pearl says the shop has a whole shelf of them.

tasks.prompt: Pearl's car door has a pattern on it. Read what it shows.
tasks.success: Five yellow stars shine on the door of Pearl's car.

tasks.prompt: On the back seat there is already a passenger. Read who it is and what is going on.
tasks.success: A big cat sleeps on the back seat. That is Biscuit, Pearl's cat.

tasks.prompt: We drive past a farm stand at the edge of the village. Read what is in the basket.
tasks.success: Ten red apples, shiny and round.

tasks.prompt: The car rolls over a bridge above a pond. Read what I see down there.
tasks.success: One white swan glides under the bridge.

tasks.prompt: Pearl points at an old oak by her gate. Read who peeks out of the hollow.
tasks.success: Two small owls blink at us from the hollow.

tasks.prompt: On Pearl's chimney, someone is welcoming us. Read who it is.
tasks.success: A black bird sings from the top of the chimney. Welcome to Maple Hollow!

chapters.title: Pearl's Studio
chapters.completeText: The first banner is drying by the window. Tomorrow Pearl takes us to the market for the things she still needs.

tasks.prompt: Pearl's studio smells of fresh paint. Read what she has dabbed on the first banner.
tasks.success: Nine green dots, in two neat rows.

tasks.prompt: Something has rolled out from under Pearl's easel. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A big orange ball - Biscuit must have been playing with it.

tasks.prompt: Pearl lets us choose a stamp for our hands. Read what she stamps on mine.
tasks.success: Two purple hearts on my hand - they will wash off later.

tasks.prompt: Pearl holds up a picture she made for a children's book. Read who is on the page and what is happening.
tasks.success: A small cat laughs so hard that tears roll down.

tasks.prompt: Pearl cuts shapes out of paper for a window. Read what she has cut so far.
tasks.success: Three blue squares, ready for the window.

tasks.prompt: Pearl takes something down from a hook by the door. Read what she takes.
tasks.success: One black hat - Pearl wears it for luck when she paints.

tasks.prompt: Pearl opens a drawer full of odds and ends. Read what she hands us.
tasks.success: Two big pencils - one for me and one for you.

tasks.prompt: On Pearl's easel stands a half-finished painting. Read who is in it and what is happening.
tasks.success: A white sheep sleeps in the painting, curled up like a cloud.

tasks.prompt: On the top shelf, Pearl keeps her favorite things. Read what is up there.
tasks.success: Four red books, full of Pearl's old sketches.

tasks.prompt: Someone from next door has come to visit the studio. Read who it is and what is going on.
tasks.success: A small dog sings along while Pearl hums. He visits every afternoon.

chapters.title: The Village Market
chapters.completeText: Pearl's bag is so full that Farmer Lin offers to drive it home. Tomorrow she invites us to her orchard!

tasks.prompt: The market opens early on the village green. Read what the first stall is selling.
tasks.success: Six yellow lemons, so sour that I make a face.

tasks.prompt: Farmer Lin has a cart of vegetables. Read what she puts in Pearl's bag.
tasks.success: Two green peppers for Pearl's soup tonight.

tasks.prompt: A boy at the next stall shows us something he has grown. Read what he holds up.
tasks.success: A big orange carrot - he pulled it up all by himself!

tasks.prompt: Pearl stops at a stall to buy her lunch. Read what she picks.
tasks.success: One red tomato - Pearl eats it like an apple.

tasks.prompt: Behind the market there is a pen with fresh straw. Read who is inside and what is happening.
tasks.success: Three pigs sleep in the straw, snoring softly.

tasks.prompt: A grandma at the fruit stall has a present for me. Read what she hands me.
tasks.success: A small green apple - crunchy and a bit sour.

tasks.prompt: The fruit seller hangs a net bag above his stall. Read what is in it.
tasks.success: Four yellow bananas, ripe and sweet.

tasks.prompt: At the toy stall, Pearl buys a prize for the festival raffle. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A big brown bear, soft and cuddly, for the raffle.

tasks.prompt: A puppet show starts at the end of the market. Read who is on the stage and what is happening.
tasks.success: Two cats laugh until they fall over, and the children cheer.

tasks.prompt: As we leave, the stall keepers put up decorations for the festival. Read what now hangs over the market.
tasks.success: Five red flags flap in the wind - the festival is coming!

chapters.title: Farmer Lin's Orchard
chapters.completeText: Our baskets are heavy and our cheeks are pink. Tomorrow Pearl wants to sketch by the duck pond.

tasks.prompt: Farmer Lin walks us between her rows of trees. Read what falls into my hand.
tasks.success: Three red leaves - the first ones of autumn.

tasks.prompt: High in the oldest tree there is a nest. Read who is in it and what is happening.
tasks.success: A black bird sleeps in the nest. Shh, let's walk softly.

tasks.prompt: Farmer Lin shakes a low branch. Read what drops into the grass.
tasks.success: Two small pears drop into the grass. Not ripe yet!

tasks.prompt: At the end of the row, something lies across the path. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A big brown log - we sit on it to rest.

tasks.prompt: Farmer Lin lets us pick from the last tree. Read what I get.
tasks.success: One green apple, the very last one on the tree.

tasks.prompt: Beyond the orchard fence, the forest begins. Read who is out there and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Two bears sing a deep, rumbly song in the forest.

tasks.prompt: Farmer Lin fills a basket from her farm for Pearl. Read what is in it.
tasks.success: Eight red apples for Pearl's apple pie.

tasks.prompt: Something is hiding in the grass under a tree. Read what I spot.
tasks.success: A small yellow chick! It has wandered away from the hens.

tasks.prompt: Farmer Lin points at a hole under the hedge. Read who lives there.
tasks.success: Three small foxes - the cubs come out to play at dusk.

tasks.prompt: At the gate, Farmer Lin has a present for the festival table. Read what she gives us.
tasks.success: A big red apple, polished until it shines.

chapters.title: The Duck Pond
chapters.completeText: Pearl's sketchbook is full of the pond. Tomorrow we help Baker Otto get ready for the festival.

tasks.prompt: Pearl takes us to the pond to sketch. Read who swims out from the reeds.
tasks.success: Three small ducks paddle after their mother.

tasks.prompt: On a lily pad there are visitors. Read who is there and what is happening.
tasks.success: Two frogs sing - ribbit, ribbit!

tasks.prompt: Pearl asks me to stop sketching and look around. Read what I see.
tasks.success: Two white swans glide side by side.

tasks.prompt: Pearl shows me a stone by the water. Read what is on it.
tasks.success: A big green frog - it blinks and stays put.

tasks.prompt: The wind blows across the pond. Read what floats on the water now.
tasks.success: Five green leaves float by like boats.

tasks.prompt: There is a warm rock at the edge of the pond. Read who is on it and what is happening.
tasks.success: A small turtle sleeps in the sun.

tasks.prompt: A boy on the other bank is searching the reeds. Read what Pearl finds there.
tasks.success: One yellow ball - the boy waves thank you!

tasks.prompt: Pearl puts down her brush and listens. Read who is on the log and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Three turtles sing a slow pond song.

tasks.prompt: Something lands on the rail of the bridge. Read what has landed.
tasks.success: A big white bird rests on the rail for a moment.

tasks.prompt: As we pack up, Pearl points at the bank near us. Read who is on it and what is going on.
tasks.success: A white swan sings goodbye - well, it honks.

chapters.title: Otto's Bakery
chapters.completeText: The festival cake is in the cold room, and Otto is fast asleep in his chair. Tomorrow Farmer Lin needs help in the meadow.

tasks.prompt: Baker Otto lets us behind his counter before the festival rush. Read what is lined up there.
tasks.success: Three big eggs - Otto says they come from Farmer Lin's hens.

tasks.prompt: Behind the flour sacks, Otto has guests he pretends not to see. Read who they are and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Two mice sing a squeaky song behind the flour.

tasks.prompt: Otto pipes icing on top of a cake. Read what he draws.
tasks.success: A big pink heart in sugar icing.

tasks.prompt: Otto lifts a cover off a tray on the counter. Read what is underneath.
tasks.success: One big cake for the festival, with candles on top.

tasks.prompt: Someone is at the bakery door, looking in at the cakes. Read who it is and what is going on.
tasks.success: A small cat cries at the door, so Otto gives her a drop of milk.

tasks.prompt: Otto's floor has an old tile pattern by the door. Read what I count there.
tasks.success: Seven green squares in the old tile floor.

tasks.prompt: Outside the bakery, the delivery cart is waiting. Read who is in the cart and what is happening.
tasks.success: Two dogs sleep in the cart until it is time to deliver the bread.

tasks.prompt: Otto cuts cookies with a cookie cutter. Read what shapes are on the tray.
tasks.success: Five yellow hearts, warm and smelling of lemon.

tasks.prompt: A customer has tied up a pet outside the window. Read who it is and what it is doing.
tasks.success: A big dog sings - Otto says he does that whenever he smells cake.

tasks.prompt: At the end of the day, Otto hands us a paper bag. Read what is inside.
tasks.success: Two big cookies - one for each of us!

chapters.title: The Sheep Meadow
chapters.completeText: Farmer Lin gives Pearl a bag of soft wool for the festival. Tomorrow we visit Granny Willa's garden.

tasks.prompt: Farmer Lin shows us the meadow behind her barn. Read what I see when I look up the hill.
tasks.success: Nine white sheep, fluffy as clouds.

tasks.prompt: Someone is by the fence near us. Read who it is and what is going on.
tasks.success: A white sheep sings - baa! - right at me.

tasks.prompt: Farmer Lin calls her animals over to the gate. Read who comes.
tasks.success: Two big cows amble over and moo hello.

tasks.prompt: In the shade of the old tree, Farmer Lin points at something. Read who is there and what is happening.
tasks.success: Three cows sleep in the shade, side by side.

tasks.prompt: Something peeks out from behind the haystack. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A small pink pig - Farmer Lin calls her Rosie.

tasks.prompt: Near the barn door, Farmer Lin has a pair of new arrivals. Read who they are and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Two pigs sing for their supper - oink, oink!

tasks.prompt: We lie on our backs in the meadow. Read what is above us.
tasks.success: Four white clouds - one of them looks like a sheep.

tasks.prompt: Farmer Lin's grandson wants to play in the meadow. Read what he brings.
tasks.success: A big brown ball, the kind you throw, not kick.

tasks.prompt: In the barn, something stirs in the straw. Read who it is and what it is doing.
tasks.success: A small cow sleeps in the straw - a calf, only a week old.

tasks.prompt: Before we leave, Farmer Lin lets me pick some from the edge of the meadow. Read what I take home.
tasks.success: Three yellow flowers for Pearl's studio window.

chapters.title: Granny Willa's Garden
chapters.completeText: Granny Willa promises to bring her best flowers to the festival. Tomorrow we visit the toy workshop.

tasks.prompt: Granny Willa's garden is next to the church. Read what grows by her gate.
tasks.success: Four pink flowers - the last ones of Granny's summer.

tasks.prompt: Granny Willa gives me a pot to carry. Read what is planted in it.
tasks.success: A small purple flower - Granny says it smells like summer.

tasks.prompt: Under the bean poles there is a nest of straw. Read who is there and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Two chicks sing - cheep, cheep - under the beans.

tasks.prompt: Granny Willa shows me a plant by the shed. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A big yellow flower, taller than me!

tasks.prompt: In a flowerpot tipped on its side, there is a visitor. Read who is in it and what is going on.
tasks.success: A small mouse sleeps in the flowerpot, curled up in the moss.

tasks.prompt: Granny Willa ties a bunch with string for Pearl's table. Read what is in it.
tasks.success: Seven red flowers - roses from Granny's best bush.

tasks.prompt: In the corner of the garden there is a pond with a flat stone. Read who is on the stone and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Two frogs sleep on the stone in the sun.

tasks.prompt: Granny Willa shows me a cushion she is sewing for the festival. Read what is on it.
tasks.success: A big white flower, stitched in shiny thread.

tasks.prompt: At the edge of the pond, Pearl points at the bank. Read what I find there.
tasks.success: One green frog - it jumps in with a plop!

tasks.prompt: As the sun goes down, Granny Willa points at her apple tree. Read who is up there.
tasks.success: A small owl sings, hoo-hoo, from the apple tree.

chapters.title: Mr. Bramble's Toy Workshop
chapters.completeText: The prize box is full and Mr. Bramble's hands are covered in sawdust. Tomorrow, though, the sky looks gray.

tasks.prompt: Mr. Bramble's workbench is covered with prizes for the festival. Read what is on it.
tasks.success: Three red cars, with wheels that really turn.

tasks.prompt: Mr. Bramble has cut a shape from glass for a window. Read what he holds up to the light.
tasks.success: A big blue diamond - the light shines straight through it.

tasks.prompt: In the back of the workshop there are instruments for the parade band. Read what Mr. Bramble has finished.
tasks.success: Two big drums - boom, boom!

tasks.prompt: Under the workbench there is a basket of wood shavings. Read who is in it and what is happening.
tasks.success: A small dog sleeps in the shavings. Mr. Bramble calls him Chips.

tasks.prompt: Mr. Bramble paints a game board for the prize stall. Read what is on it so far.
tasks.success: Ten blue dots, in two rows of five.

tasks.prompt: On the shelf above the bench, there are plans for every toy. Read what Mr. Bramble takes down.
tasks.success: One orange book, full of toy plans.

tasks.prompt: By the window, Mr. Bramble keeps a big cage with perches. Read who lives in it and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Two parrots sing a whistling song for every customer.

tasks.prompt: Mr. Bramble gives me a toy to test on the floor. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A small yellow car - a taxi! It zooms across the floor.

tasks.prompt: On the top shelf sits the oldest toy in the workshop. Read who it is and what it is doing.
tasks.success: A brown bear sings when you wind the key in his back.

tasks.prompt: Mr. Bramble packs a box for the throwing game. Read what goes into it.
tasks.success: Three white balls for the throwing game - aim well!

chapters.title: A Rainy Afternoon
chapters.completeText: The rain stops just before supper, and a rainbow comes out over the hill. Tomorrow we walk the forest path.

tasks.prompt: Rain drums on the roof, so we stay in. Read who climbs into my lap and what happens.
tasks.success: A big cat kisses my nose - Biscuit wants to play.

tasks.prompt: Pearl gets out a board game. Read what is on the first card.
tasks.success: Four green squares - I move four steps!

tasks.prompt: Pearl reads us a story from an old book. Read who is in the picture and what is happening.
tasks.success: Two cats cry - they have lost their mittens!

tasks.prompt: Pearl lets me choose the next story. Read what I pick.
tasks.success: A small red book of fairy tales.

tasks.prompt: Through the rainy window, Pearl points at the garden wall. Read who is looking in at us.
tasks.success: One black cat - Inky from next door wants to come in.

tasks.prompt: We build a pillow fort, and my toy friends move in. Read who is in the fort and what is going on.
tasks.success: A small pig sleeps in the fort - my toy pig, Pinky.

tasks.prompt: Pearl gives us paper and a brush. Read what I paint first.
tasks.success: Eight orange dots, like little suns.

tasks.prompt: Pearl sorts a box of old animal figures. Read who she puts on the table.
tasks.success: Two big hippos - Pearl made them when she was a girl.

tasks.prompt: Pearl shows us a painting she made of a winter night. Read who is in it and what is happening.
tasks.success: A white bird sleeps in a snowy tree.

tasks.prompt: At bedtime, Pearl puts on a film about Africa. Read who is on the screen and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Three lions sing - well, they roar - and then the film ends.

chapters.title: The Forest Path
chapters.completeText: Hazel flies ahead to show us the way home. Tomorrow Farmer Lin's barn has a show of its own.

tasks.prompt: Our guide Hazel meets us where the forest path begins. Read who is in the tree behind her and what is happening.
tasks.success: Two owls sleep in the tree - Hazel's sisters, who stay up all night.

tasks.prompt: Hazel shows us footprints in the mud by the stream. Read who made them.
tasks.success: A small brown bear - a cub, fishing in the stream.

tasks.prompt: In a clearing, Hazel stops us with a wing. Read who is there and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Three foxes sing a yippy song in the clearing.

tasks.prompt: The wind shakes the maple tree above us. Read what drifts down.
tasks.success: Five red leaves drift down onto my hat.

tasks.prompt: Hazel points at a hollow log. Read who is inside and what is going on.
tasks.success: A small bear sleeps in the log - shh, don't wake him.

tasks.prompt: Among the roots of a beech tree, Hazel shows us a hiding place. Read who peeks out.
tasks.success: Three small mice peek out and twitch their whiskers.

tasks.prompt: High above the path, something sits on a branch. Read what it is and what it is doing.
tasks.success: A white bird sings a clear, sweet song.

tasks.prompt: Hazel takes us to the oldest oak in the forest. Read who is waiting there.
tasks.success: One big owl - Hazel's grandmother, the wisest bird in the forest.

tasks.prompt: Hazel shows us one more tree, with a deep hollow. Read who is in the hollow and what is happening.
tasks.success: A big owl sleeps in the hollow. He works the night shift.

tasks.prompt: At the end of the path there is a clearing. Read what is lying in the grass.
tasks.success: Four brown logs around an old fire pit - a perfect place to rest.

chapters.title: The Barn Choir
chapters.completeText: The barn choir will open the festival parade. Tonight there is a lantern walk through the village!

tasks.prompt: Farmer Lin opens the barn for us after lunch. Read who is in the first stall and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Three cows sing - moo, moo, moo - in perfect time.

tasks.prompt: Farmer Lin points to the barn door. Read who is waiting by it.
tasks.success: Two big dogs wag their tails - they guard the farm.

tasks.prompt: In the next stall, someone sits on an upturned bucket. Read who it is and what is happening.
tasks.success: A small pig sings a solo, and we all clap.

tasks.prompt: Pearl looks up at the hayloft. Read who is up there and what is going on.
tasks.success: One dog sings along from the hayloft - a bit out of tune.

tasks.prompt: Pearl paints a sign for the show and hangs it over the stage. Read what is on it.
tasks.success: A big yellow star - the barn show is ready!

tasks.prompt: In a box of straw under a warm lamp, there are some little ones. Read who they are and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Three chicks sleep under the lamp in a fluffy heap.

tasks.prompt: Farmer Lin hands out tickets for the show. Read what is printed on mine.
tasks.success: Two red hearts on my ticket - front row seats!

tasks.prompt: At the back of the barn, Farmer Lin lifts a lantern. Read who is there and what is going on.
tasks.success: A small cow sings - the calf has learned to moo!

tasks.prompt: On the barn roof, the audience is arriving. Read who has come to listen.
tasks.success: Two black birds sit on the roof beam, ready for the show.

tasks.prompt: Farmer Lin checks the last stall in the barn. Read who is in it and what it is doing.
tasks.success: A big pig sleeps and snores louder than the whole choir.

chapters.title: The Lantern Walk
chapters.completeText: We hang our lanterns by Pearl's door to light the way home. Tomorrow, if it is windy, we go up Kite Hill.

tasks.prompt: At dusk, the village children walk with paper lanterns. From the hill, Pearl tells me to look down. Read what I see.
tasks.success: Six red dots - six lanterns bobbing along the road.

tasks.prompt: As we pass the church tower, Pearl stops and listens. Read who is up in the tower.
tasks.success: Two owls sing to the moon from the church tower.

tasks.prompt: My lantern has a window cut in its paper. Read what shape glows in it.
tasks.success: A small blue heart glows in my lantern.

tasks.prompt: The clouds blow away, and the sky clears. Read what I count above the roofs.
tasks.success: Nine yellow stars - and more coming out every minute.

tasks.prompt: In the bakery window, Otto's lamp is still on. Read who is on the windowsill and what is happening.
tasks.success: A small cat sleeps on the windowsill, warm from the oven.

tasks.prompt: We tiptoe past Mr. Bramble's porch. Read who is on the doormat.
tasks.success: Three dogs sleep on the doormat, nose to tail.

tasks.prompt: In the church window, someone has lit something for the festival. Read what glows there.
tasks.success: Two big candles flicker behind the glass.

tasks.prompt: Pearl shines her lantern on a garden wall. Read who is there and what is going on.
tasks.success: A black cat sleeps on the wall - it's Inky, out for the night.

tasks.prompt: The toy shop window has a moving display for the festival. Read who is in it.
tasks.success: A white bear sings a winter song in the toy shop window.

tasks.prompt: At the end of the walk, Pearl ties something to my wrist. Read what she ties.
tasks.success: A big red balloon to carry home - I tie it to my bed.

chapters.title: Kite Hill
chapters.completeText: Our kite flew higher than the church tower! Tomorrow Mr. Bramble invites us to his puppet show rehearsal.

tasks.prompt: On top of Kite Hill, someone has marked the start line for the kite race. Read what is stuck in the grass.
tasks.success: Three red flags flutter at the start line.

tasks.prompt: Pearl lies down in the grass and points at the sky. Read what she sees.
tasks.success: A big white cloud, shaped like a kite.

tasks.prompt: Mr. Bramble arrives with his own handmade ones. Read what he carries up the hill.
tasks.success: Two big kites, ready to fly.

tasks.prompt: On the fence at the bottom of the hill, something is watching the kites. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A small black bird watches with its head on one side.

tasks.prompt: Families have brought their pets up the hill. Read who is on the blanket next to us and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Two dogs sing whenever a kite swoops low.

tasks.prompt: A girl shows me the pattern on her kite. Read what is on it.
tasks.success: One orange diamond in the middle of her kite.

tasks.prompt: In the one tree on the hill, there is a visitor on a branch. Read who it is and what is going on.
tasks.success: A small owl sleeps through all the noise.

tasks.prompt: At the bottom of the hill, I look along the fence. Read what is on the posts.
tasks.success: Four white flags mark the finish line.

tasks.prompt: Next to our picnic blanket, someone has stretched out on the grass. Read who it is and what is happening.
tasks.success: A big dog sleeps on the grass after chasing every kite.

tasks.prompt: As the sun sets, something flies over the hill toward the pond. Read what flies past.
tasks.success: Two white birds fly home together over the hill.

chapters.title: The Puppet Show
chapters.completeText: The puppets are ready for the festival. Tomorrow Pearl takes us to the costume shop!

tasks.prompt: Mr. Bramble is rehearsing his puppet show for the festival. Read who comes on stage first and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Two pandas sing a bamboo song, and then they bow.

tasks.prompt: Next, the curtain opens on the jungle scene. Read who is there and what is happening.
tasks.success: A big lion sleeps, and the mouse puppets tiptoe past.

tasks.prompt: In the jungle trees, more puppets appear. Read who they are and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Three monkeys sing so loudly that the paper trees shake.

tasks.prompt: Mr. Bramble lowers a puppet tree onto the stage. Read who is on the branch.
tasks.success: A small koala sleeps on the branch, hugging it tight.

tasks.prompt: At the end of the first act, the puppet friends come back on stage. Read who is there and what happens.
tasks.success: Two cats kiss, and everyone in the hall says aww.

tasks.prompt: The puppet stage has a painted floor. Read what is painted on it.
tasks.success: Four purple squares, like a royal carpet.

tasks.prompt: Now it is the river scene. Read who is in the river and what is going on.
tasks.success: A small hippo sings a bubbly song in the paper river.

tasks.prompt: For the sea scene, Mr. Bramble opens his trunk. Read what he brings out.
tasks.success: One big whale - it takes both of us to hold it.

tasks.prompt: Mr. Bramble lets me try some puppets myself. Read who is on my hands.
tasks.success: Two small tigers, one on each hand - grrr!

tasks.prompt: When the rehearsal ends, Mr. Bramble hangs the puppets back on their hooks. Read who is on the last hook and what is going on.
tasks.success: Three parrots sleep on the last hook until the festival.

chapters.title: Miss Poppy's Costume Shop
chapters.completeText: Our costumes are ready and hanging by the door. Tomorrow the whole village builds the parade float!

tasks.prompt: Miss Poppy's costume shop smells of old velvet. Read what is on the top shelf.
tasks.success: Two black hats - one for Pearl and one for me!

tasks.prompt: Miss Poppy pins a badge on my coat. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A small green heart - the badge of the festival helpers.

tasks.prompt: Pearl tries on a dress for the festival picnic. Read what is sewn on the front.
tasks.success: Three pink hearts on the front - Pearl twirls around.

tasks.prompt: Miss Poppy holds up a hat with something on the brim. Read what she has pinned there.
tasks.success: A big purple flower on the brim, nodding as she walks.

tasks.prompt: A visitor from the street has wandered into the shop and sees itself in the mirror. Read who it is and what happens.
tasks.success: A big cat laughs at the cat in the mirror.

tasks.prompt: Miss Poppy unrolls a bolt of blue cloth for the parade. Read what pattern is on it.
tasks.success: Seven white dots on blue cloth, like falling snow.

tasks.prompt: On a rail at the back hang animal costumes. Read who we will be in the parade.
tasks.success: Two big bears - Pearl and I will be the bears!

tasks.prompt: Miss Poppy needs a patch for a torn knee. Read what she sews on.
tasks.success: One blue square on the knee, as good as new.

tasks.prompt: Someone is on the shop counter, next to the till. Read who it is and what it is doing.
tasks.success: A black cat sings - it's Inky again, asking for a treat.

tasks.prompt: Before we go, Miss Poppy shows us where she keeps her costume ideas. Read what she keeps them in.
tasks.success: A big orange book, full of sketches of hats.

chapters.title: Building the Float
chapters.completeText: The float is finished and covered with a sheet for the night. Tomorrow is the Color Festival!

tasks.prompt: Pearl paints the sides of the parade wagon. Read what she has painted on the left side.
tasks.success: Ten green squares in two tidy rows along the side.

tasks.prompt: Farmer Lin carries the centerpiece for the front of the wagon. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A big red heart for the front of the float - Maple Hollow says welcome!

tasks.prompt: Mr. Bramble hangs decorations on strings along the top of the wagon. Read what is dangling there.
tasks.success: Three small stars twinkle on their strings.

tasks.prompt: Under the wagon, in the shade, someone has found a cool spot. Read who is there.
tasks.success: Two cats sleep under the wagon, side by side in the shade.

tasks.prompt: Otto brings a gift for the float. Read what he has brought.
tasks.success: One red balloon for the wagon - and Otto says more are on the way.

tasks.prompt: Granny Willa has carved a figure for the top of the float. Read what she carved.
tasks.success: A small white swan of painted wood, for the very top.

tasks.prompt: Farmer Lin's animals come to see what all the fuss is about. Read who is first at the wagon.
tasks.success: A big pig sings - he wants to ride on the float too!

tasks.prompt: The back of the wagon still needs a pattern. Read what Pearl paints there.
tasks.success: Five orange squares across the back, bright as sunsets.

tasks.prompt: In the straw on the back of the wagon, someone has climbed aboard. Read who it is and what is going on.
tasks.success: A pink pig sleeps in the straw - Rosie wants a ride in the parade!

tasks.prompt: When the float is done, we all sit on the grass. Read who wanders over to us.
tasks.success: Two small chicks peep and peck at our crumbs.

chapters.title: The Parade
chapters.completeText: The parade ends on the village green, where the tables are set for a picnic. Hooray for the Color Festival!

tasks.prompt: On festival morning, the whole street is decorated. Read what hangs from the windows.
tasks.success: Six white flags wave from the windows.

tasks.prompt: The barn choir rides at the front of the parade on a hay cart. Read who is on the cart.
tasks.success: Two cows sing at the front of the parade - moo!

tasks.prompt: Behind the choir comes the mayor. Read what she rides in.
tasks.success: A big blue car, with ribbons on the doors.

tasks.prompt: Children along the road wave paper fans. Read what is painted on mine.
tasks.success: A small red heart on my paper fan.

tasks.prompt: Mr. Bramble's puppet float rolls by. Read who is on top and what is going on.
tasks.success: One lion sings from the top of the float - a puppet, of course!

tasks.prompt: Then it is our turn to march in our costumes. Read who the crowd sees.
tasks.success: Two big bears - the crowd laughs and waves at us!

tasks.prompt: Granny Willa throws something from her garden float. Read what lands in my hands.
tasks.success: Seven purple hearts made of paper - confetti!

tasks.prompt: Someone is up on the bakery sign, watching the parade. Read who it is.
tasks.success: A small black cat - Inky has the best seat in town.

tasks.prompt: The last float is covered in shiny paper shapes. Read what is on it.
tasks.success: Ten yellow stars glitter on the last float.

tasks.prompt: At the end of the parade, the toy shop float stops in front of us. Read who is on it and what is happening.
tasks.success: A white bear sleeps on the toy float, missing all the fun.

chapters.title: The Picnic on the Green
chapters.completeText: Everyone is full and happy, and the sun is going down. One last thing tonight: the fireworks!

tasks.prompt: After the parade, everyone sits down to the picnic. Read what is in our basket.
tasks.success: Three red apples from Farmer Lin's orchard.

tasks.prompt: Otto carries over his treats from the bakery tent. Read what he puts on the table.
tasks.success: Two big cakes, and everyone gets a slice.

tasks.prompt: A clown juggles on the grass next to us. Read who is watching and what is happening.
tasks.success: Two cats laugh every time the clown drops a ball.

tasks.prompt: Granny Willa makes a drink for everyone and needs one more thing. Read what she adds.
tasks.success: A small yellow lemon - squeeze, squeeze, and the lemonade is ready!

tasks.prompt: Farmer Lin's animals have come to the picnic too. Read who is under the oak and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Three pigs sing for their share of the picnic.

tasks.prompt: I open my lunch box. Read what Pearl has packed for me.
tasks.success: One white egg, hard-boiled - my favorite.

tasks.prompt: After lunch, the children start a game on the grass. Read what Mr. Bramble throws to us.
tasks.success: A small white ball - we take turns hitting it with a stick.

tasks.prompt: On the corner of our blanket, someone has joined us. Read who it is and what is going on.
tasks.success: A big cat sleeps on our blanket - Biscuit found us!

tasks.prompt: A breeze blows across the picnic. Read what lands on our blanket.
tasks.success: Eight green leaves land on the blanket - and one in Otto's cake!

tasks.prompt: As the picnic ends, Pearl points at the church roof. Read who is up there and what is happening.
tasks.success: A black bird sings along with the village band.

chapters.title: Fireworks and Goodnight
chapters.completeText: What a visit! Pearl says the Color Festival was the brightest one ever, and we can come back next year.

tasks.prompt: When it gets dark, the fireworks begin over the pond. Read what the first one makes in the sky.
tasks.success: Five red hearts burst over the pond - ooh!

tasks.prompt: The next firework fizzes high above the church. Read what it leaves behind.
tasks.success: A big green dot that fizzes and sparkles.

tasks.prompt: Then the whole sky fills with sparkles. Read what I count.
tasks.success: Ten yellow stars - the best firework of all!

tasks.prompt: On the way home we pass Pearl's porch, where some of the village pets are waiting. Read who is there and what is happening.
tasks.success: Three cats cry at the bangs, so Pearl lets them in.

tasks.prompt: The fireworks light up the pond below. Read what I see there.
tasks.success: Two white swans float calmly under the fireworks.

tasks.prompt: Back at Pearl's cottage, the old oak by the gate has a visitor. Read who has come.
tasks.success: A big owl sings goodnight to the whole village.

tasks.prompt: Granny Willa comes to say goodbye and gives me a present. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A big pink flower to press in my book.

tasks.prompt: Back in my room, I line up my toys on the pillow. Read who is there and what is going on.
tasks.success: Two bears sleep on my pillow - my old teddy and the new one from Maple Hollow.

tasks.prompt: Pearl hangs a new painting on the wall of my room. Read who is in it and what is happening.
tasks.success: A white sheep sleeps in the painting - Pearl finished it just for me!

tasks.prompt: Outside my window, the oak by the gate rustles one last time. Read who says goodnight from the hollow.
tasks.success: Two small owls blink goodnight. See you next year, Maple Hollow!
